provenance.authorization: NHL 2026 — ADD POINTS + SAVES TO 8RAIN OPERATIONAL EXPORT, 2026-10-01
provenance.prior_policy_search: No authorized operational Points candidate policy found; prior preseason readiness artifacts classified Points candidate execution as blocked pending an explicit policy.
provenance.rationale: Use current-slate market-attached predictions only. Require a usable side-specific sportsbook price, positive expected value at that price, and positive model-versus-market probability gap. No threshold was tuned on current-slate outcomes.
provenance.threshold_basis: Strictly greater than zero for EV and model-market gap; no line, price, or candidate-count cutoff.

identity.duplicate_handling: Fail closed on duplicate source prediction keys or conflicting candidate keys; preserve distinct props, lines, and sides.

paired_export: The thin 8rain adapter emits the complementary model probability for the opposite side of each selected player/prop/line.
